prompts.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: ultra-wide exterior night backdrop plate for the Cuddlecore kitchen, part of a matched day/night/weather set.
Reference image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and sole composition master: 14-window-rain.png. Convert THIS exact view to NIGHT, about 11 PM. Output ONE full-bleed 3:1 landscape image at the same 2172x724 canvas. No crop, zoom, tilt, pan, lens/perspective change or reframing. Keep the sea horizon at its current height.
MOST IMPORTANT: identical geometry at identical image coordinates. The garden stone wall and every coping stone, rooted rosemary positions, main field/hedgerow boundaries, bay shoreline, offshore rocks, distant headland silhouettes must remain fixed. Do not redraw, replace or rearrange the coast. This plate cross-fades with the rainy DAY master, so rooted landmarks must not jump. Ground floor eye height about 1.6m, natural sharp photographic landscape, extended 35mm coverage.
NIGHT EXPOSURE: genuinely dark 11pm, land MOSTLY SILHOUETTE. Preserve recognizable silhouettes with very little internal detail. No lifted HDR shadows, no bright blue daytime land, no milky bright sky, no day-for-night blue wash. Most land should be near black charcoal/deep blue-black; detail only where a believable light reaches it. The sky is dark. No moon visible in sky, water reflections of a visible moon disc, or sun. Photographic realism.
Cottage lights, when requested, must be only a few tiny warm window points along the EXISTING opposite shore across the bay, houses otherwise hidden in silhouette; no new buildings or changed landform. Rain is only IN AIR, never on glass or the lens.
EXCLUSIONS: no window, frame, glass, curtains, room, sill, lens drops or glass rain streaks, reflections of interior, people, animals, cars, text, signs, logos, watermark, borders, montage.
WEATHER — RAIN: steady rain and low dark cloud faintly glowing from a distant town BEYOND the far headland, town itself not visible. A FEW tiny warm cottage windows across the bay. Wet garden stone wall catches just a little faint light from the inn behind camera, enough to recognize its same outline, not floodlit. Sea is dark gray-black, rain and distance softly obscure the headlands without moving them. No stars, moon, lightning or lighthouse beam in this Rain version. Keep it dark; most land is silhouette, not dusk.
